changes: CPA v8 grouped API keys appear in the inventory; supported keys can check balance on demand using their configured proxy. The console does not expose credentials or change routing (0.10.2–0.10.3)

Each account goes out through its own proxy_url (the route Coding Tools gives every CPA credential): requests, model syncs, balance reads and Test no longer use CPA's one global proxy, and a marker re-saved after a model-list change keeps its proxy_url (0.10.1)

Upstream cards keep each account's usage across CPA restarts; quota bars show what is left; Moonshot and StepFun balance formats are supported; AI Studio shows no card until an account is signed in (0.10.1)

CPA's own rotation and its rate-limit cooldowns pick accounts again: CPA Helper's quota polling, smart routing, out-of-credit key blocks, opt-in fallbacks, Codex reset credits and keeper are gone; usage and cost history, the price book and key labels stay (0.10.0)
CPA's Plugins sidebar shows one entry, Provider Manager; Auto Review, Cline Pass and the usage history are pages in its console (0.10.0)
CPA loads only Provider Manager: CPA Helper, CPA Auto Review, Cline Pass, CommandCode Go, CommandCode and Grok are its parts
Cline Pass, CommandCode Go, CommandCode and Grok accounts are provider-manager auth files with a kind; their models, logins and management routes are unchanged
